summary: Frontend-only verification of the HeaderMenu (floating glass pill) bug fix across widths 1920, 1440, 1280, 1024, 900, 820, 768, 390. FUNCTIONALITY is intact (nav smooth-scroll works, Get Started -> /auth?trial=true, Log In -> /auth?mode=login, hamburger opens/closes mobile dropdown, mobile CTA navigates). NO horizontal viewport overflow at any tested width (docScrollWidth == vw). HOWEVER, the primary bug is NOT fully fixed: at desktop widths 1024-1200 the 'Get Started' button visually overflows the frosted pill's right edge (button.right > pill.right by 30-100px), so the CTA appears OUTSIDE the pill's frosted background. At >=1250 the CTA is inside the pill. The user-reported clipping/off-pill behavior therefore still reproduces on common laptop widths.

ui_bugs.issue: At widths 1024-1200 the pill is sized smaller than its content, so the Get Started button (header-cta-btn) visually overflows the pill's right edge. Measured bounding rects (window.innerWidth / pill.width / pill.right / cta.right): 1024/548/786/843.84 (overflow 57.8px), 1050/548/799/856.84 (overflow 57.8px), 1100/550/825/880.84 (overflow 55.8px), 1150/575/862.5/893.34 (overflow 30.8px), 1200/600/900/905.84 (overflow 5.8px), 1250 -> inside pill. Pill (data-testid=main-header) does NOT overflow the viewport itself; docScrollWidth==window.innerWidth at every width. Login button also visually sits just inside/outside depending on width. Screenshot at 1200 clearly shows 'Get Started' floating OUTSIDE the glass pill on the right.

action_items: Fix HeaderMenu.js pill sizing so the CTA is always inside the pill at widths >= 1024. Root cause: header has `flex flex-col items-center w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)] lg:w-auto`, and its inner row uses `w-full`. At lg, parent is w-auto (shrink-to-fit) while the child forces w-full, creating a circular width dependency; the browser resolves it using the min-content of the flex row (~498px), which is smaller than the natural content width (~700-780px depending on gaps), so children overflow the pill visually. Suggested fix (1-line): change the inner row in HeaderMenu.js from `<div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-x-4 lg:gap-x-8">` to `<div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full lg:w-auto gap-x-4 lg:gap-x-8">`. Alternative: on the outer header replace `flex flex-col items-center` with `flex flex-col items-stretch lg:items-center` and keep it — or drop the outer flex-col at lg (use only for mobile dropdown). Verify at 1024/1100/1200 that button.right <= pill.right - 12.
critical_code_review_comments: HeaderMenu.js line 54: `<div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full ...">` inside a `w-auto` parent (at lg) creates a circular width dependency. Either drop `w-full` at lg or drop `w-auto` on the parent at lg.

HeaderMenu.js line 48: `max-w-[calc(100vw-1.5rem)]` is fine, but `w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)]` fights `lg:w-auto` intent because the inner `w-full` still stretches to 100% of that base sizing on lg. Consider consolidating width rules.
12 console 401s appear on the public landing page from background API probes (mostly harmless but noisy). Consider gating those calls on authenticated state.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (layout bug at 1024-1200 remains; all functionality passes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-verify at widths 1024, 1050, 1100, 1150, 1200, 1250, 1280, 1440, 1920 using window.getComputedStyle + getBoundingClientRect on data-testid='main-header' and data-testid='header-cta-btn'. Acceptance: button.right <= pill.right at every desktop width, AND pill horizontally centered (|pill.left - (vw - pill.right)| < 2). Mobile flows (hamburger, mobile CTA) already verified passing at 390/768/820/900 — no re-verification needed unless HeaderMenu structural changes are made. Cookie banner accept step can be skipped for header measurements (it does not affect header layout).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In HeaderMenu.js, the header uses `flex flex-col items-center ... w-[calc(100%-1.5rem)] lg:w-auto` while the inner flex row uses `w-full`. At lg the parent is intended to shrink-to-fit its content, but the child forces itself to 100% of the parent. The browser resolves this circular constraint using the min-content width of the flex row (~498px), so the pill is drawn narrower than its natural content width (~700-780px). Fixed-min-width children (Get Started button) then overflow the pill on the right. Reproduction: open https://revenue-exec.preview.emergentagent.com/ at 1024x900 and measure `document.querySelector('[data-testid=header-cta-btn]').getBoundingClientRect().right` vs `document.querySelector('[data-testid=main-header]').getBoundingClientRect().right`. Mitigation: add `lg:w-auto` to the inner flex row OR drop the outer flex-col wrapper on lg breakpoints. Docs/window.innerWidth never overflows (docScrollWidth == vw), so it's a visual pill-clipping bug, not a horizontal-scroll bug — but visually the button appears outside the frosted pill on typical 13"-15" laptops (~1280-1440 with browser chrome resulting in effective vw of ~1024-1200).
